title: Lomaru District Health Center EHR (Country B)
description: The district health center's OHS-based record system in Onesa (Country B), on a tablet (J3): verifies DVCs against its cached GDHCN trust list, imports them with provenance, adds the Onesan schedule code beside each foreign vaccine code and evaluates the national schedule. A Receiver; Country B, as a Trust Network Participant, retrieves the PKI material it uses. Its trust store is loaded before the visit, from the copy of the trust list it refreshed when last connected (for an offline clinic, about weekly); it fetches nothing during J3.

parts.title: Patient record
parts.description: The health centre's record of each patient, where imported immunizations are kept with their provenance (J3).

parts.title: Code mapping service (product to Onesan EPI)
parts.description: Maps a foreign vaccine product code to the Onesan EPI schedule code, which is added beside the original code on import (J3).

parts.title: Schedule evaluator (Onesan infant schedule)
parts.description: Evaluates the Onesan infant immunization schedule against the child's doses, imported ones included, and says which are due (J3).

parts.title: DVC verifier
parts.description: Verifies a DVC's HCERT signature against the GDHCN trust list cached on the device (J3).
